subject: calib_head
purpose: ground-truth calibration of the registration + silhouette-IoU pipeline and its sensitivity

registration_image_vs_instrument_iou.note: reference PNG digitized via manifest only (alpha>0.5); 1-3 edge cells differ per view of ~255 occupied -> noise floor ~0.01

crest_mirrored.note: TOP blind: crest footprint lies inside the cranium outline -- silhouette IoU cannot see interior features

conclusions: manifest pixel->world mapping is correct (a one-cell shift would read ~0.85)
IoU noise floor at n=32 ~ 0.01; small features (ears) move IoU ~0.015 -- near the floor; use n=64 or ratios for them
IoU >= 0.95 alone accepts a 10% jaw error (0.969); state the target together with reference-derived ratios within 0.02
silhouette IoU is outline-only; interior features need eye id/depth renders
live-context fixes verified by the suite: plan.build/preflight no longer use bpy.context.object; eye._targets uses scene.objects
